title: Sustainability And Green Building
document_title: SSX Master Sustainability and Green-Building Compliance Activities

items.text: What requirement applies? | Code, owner standard, rating-system prerequisite, credit, performance target or reporting obligation
cells: Code, owner standard, rating-system prerequisite, credit, performance target or reporting obligation

items.text: Where? | Site, material, building, floor, room, system, work package or supply chain
cells: Site, material, building, floor, room, system, work package or supply chain

items.text: Who owns it? | Owner, designer, contractor, subcontractor, supplier, commissioning authority or consultant
cells: Owner, designer, contractor, subcontractor, supplier, commissioning authority or consultant

items.text: When is evidence needed? | Design review, submittal, procurement, delivery, installation, testing, turnover or performance period
cells: Design review, submittal, procurement, delivery, installation, testing, turnover or performance period

items.text: What action earns compliance? | Selection, calculation, protection, segregation, testing, commissioning, training or reporting
cells: Selection, calculation, protection, segregation, testing, commissioning, training or reporting

items.text: What evidence is required? | Product declaration, certificate, invoice, waste ticket, photograph, test result, model, narrative or signed form
cells: Product declaration, certificate, invoice, waste ticket, photograph, test result, model, narrative or signed form

items.text: What threatens compliance? | Late selection, unavailable product, missing documentation, substitution, contamination, failed testing or incomplete commissioning
cells: Late selection, unavailable product, missing documentation, substitution, contamination, failed testing or incomplete commissioning

items.text: How is it closed? | Reviewed evidence, resolved comments, submitted package, certification decision or documented owner acceptance
cells: Reviewed evidence, resolved comments, submitted package, certification decision or documented owner acceptance

items.text: Integrate requirements into design and specifications
Implement site, waste and IAQ plans
Install preferred parking or mobility features
Install silt fence and inlet protection
Verify fixture flow and flush rates
Declare labels or equivalent program evidence
Local or regional sourcing when required
Complete pre-occupancy flush-out or air testing
Assess heat, flood, wind, seismic and wildfire exposure
Identify the exact rating system and version.
Link documentation need-by dates to procurement releases.
Verify evidence before purchasing products that depend on credit eligibility.
Collect waste tickets and product evidence continuously.
Schedule IAQ, moisture and pollution controls before affected work.
Include testing, commissioning, flush-out and review durations.
Maintain buffer credits where certification risk warrants.
Assign one accountable owner to every requirement.
Transfer ongoing performance duties to the owner.
